footer.non-mojang: NĀI OFISHĀRU MAINRRAFU FAN SHI. NĀI MOJANG NI YORU APROBU TO SHŪGŌ KOTO.

section1.title: SakuraLands ni yōkoso!
content: Sekai jū no tomodachi to asobu.
Epikku mini gēmu, bōken, soshite motto āru!

section2.title: Tashū-go shien!
content: Sekai jū no pūreiyā o yōkoso.
Watashitachi no komyunitī wa takusan no go ni shien suru, anata wa itsumo issho ni asobu tomodachi o mitsukeru koto ga dekimasu.
section2.warning: * Bubun no kotoba wa mashin de ransurēto da, tadashī wa nai koto ga āru.

section3.title: Tashū no mini gēmu!
content: Ōkī barie no mini gēmu: pākurū, Sukaiwāzu, Beddowāzu, Esukēpu Meiro, nado.
Itsumo shinsu ga arimasu, anata no tame ni torai suru!

section4.title: Anzen!
content: Watashitachi wa fēru purē to pūreiyā no anzen ni chūmoku shimasu.
Watashitachi no yūjō-teki na sutaffu chīmu wa anata no ekisupīriensu o anzen to tanoshī de suru koto o kakunin shimasu.
